answer.says: Ramesh, you are right. I cannot command a meal from thin air, and I will not ask you to borrow from your own pocket for my supper. I will go to the bazaar and buy what I can with the little I have. Sit down and drink your chai. I will be back before the light goes.
answer.thought: The system of needs does not close for a personal tragedy; it merely reroutes. I must go to Khan Market and buy rice and a simple vegetable, though my cash is scant. I will eat what I can, and the rest will be a discipline of the body, which is necessary before the mind can work.
